P001.idea: The book opens at the threshold. The page is the Entry Court arch itself. The reader stands with the crew under the arch, looking into a long dark lane where one hand lamp makes the only warm circle. The arch is the page shape, the title is set over it like the gateway's lintel inscription, and the whole sheet is the darkest page of the chapter. Everything after this gets lighter.
P001.role_in_opener: 1/5: darkness. Single-panel splash. Silence and scale: wonder held back by the dark.
P001.system: Book system (identical on every page, do not vary): V09 type (captions Source Serif 4 Regular 14/18 on caption paper #F7F1E3, .6pt brass #b3722f border, 5pt/8pt padding, soft shadow; speech Source Sans 3 Semibold 14/18 in ivory #FFFDF6 balloons, .8pt ink #1d2433 outline, curved P107-style tails ending short of the mouth; no speaker names). Panel frames 1pt brass + .5pt inner dark line + drop shadow, gutters 10pt, trim clearance 24pt. Border built in one full-sheet SVG like P107: rules 0.5–1.1pt, a pinstripe 12pt inside the trim broken at entry, folio and finish; strongest accent at entry (top-left) and finish (bottom-right). Moonclock folio bottom centre exactly as P107: brass ring r8 at (422,636), waxing moon lit fraction = page/107 (lit on the right), number Source Sans 3 Semibold 11pt at left:433pt top:629.5pt.

The border is the brass safety gate: its rail runs down the left edge, and the lower-store timber landing is the page's floor.

illustrate.what: SVG position strip insert (the manuscript's 'exact strip insert'): data only, no route, no solution.
illustrate.construction: Brass channel (brass gradient, 1pt #5a3510 outline, rx 4pt) with a cream enamel face #F3EBDC inset 7pt left/right and 10pt top/bottom. 11 equally spaced marks: +2, +1, 0, −1, −2, −3, −4, −5, −6, −7, −8, top to bottom, spacing 26pt (first at y=322, last at y=582). Each mark has a 6pt ink tick (.6pt) at the face's right edge and its label right-aligned at x≈58, Source Sans 3 Semibold 13pt ink #1d2433 (true minus U+2212, '+' on positives). The '0' mark is the street: its tick runs out as a 1pt brass hairline across the gutter to x=86 (the edge of P004-2) and its label is 14pt. '−8' (the store) has a lamp-gold #f7c684 dot r 2.5pt on its tick, with a faint glow: Vihaan's finger target.
illustrate.rules: No arrows, no route, no highlighted −5/−3, no lift-car glyph moving. Tag with data-figure, not data-math (no equation).

P005.idea: Lights up: the first lesson. The page turns from the dark street to calm warm paper (B1 Ledger Plate family), and the cold/warm story moves into the border and the hero. Two towns are read off one brass precision gauge standing full height down the middle of the page, frost on its cold half and lamp haze on its warm half. The border is Lantern Street's own moonline: cold silver along the top and left, warm brass along the right and bottom, meeting at the street's flat joining plates.
P005.role_in_opener: 5/5: full light. The first light page after four dark ones. Calm reading, no busy image behind any text (LESSONS 2026-11-23/24).
P005.system: Book system (identical on every page, do not vary): V09 type (captions Source Serif 4 Regular 14/18 on caption paper #F7F1E3, .6pt brass #b3722f border, 5pt/8pt padding, soft shadow; speech Source Sans 3 Semibold 14/18 in ivory #FFFDF6 balloons, .8pt ink #1d2433 outline, curved P107-style tails ending short of the mouth; no speaker names). Panel frames 1pt brass + .5pt inner dark line + drop shadow, gutters 10pt, trim clearance 24pt. Border built in one full-sheet SVG like P107: rules 0.5–1.1pt, a pinstripe 12pt inside the trim broken at entry, folio and finish; strongest accent at entry (top-left) and finish (bottom-right). Moonclock folio bottom centre exactly as P107: brass ring r8 at (422,636), waxing moon lit fraction = page/107 (lit on the right), number Source Sans 3 Semibold 11pt at left:433pt top:629.5pt. Teaching page: V09 exactly (Source Sans 3 14/18 prose, subheads Source Sans 3 Semibold 18pt, display maths 24pt, teal #1F6F6B tracked / terracotta #B5603A second role). No display fonts, no Caveat.
P005.supersedes: The old A3/A4 P005 art brief and preview (dark glass over the street plate): replace them entirely.

border.material: Lantern Street's silver moonline and its flat brass joining plate (M01 setting), plus brass gauge fittings
border.construction: A frame line 12pt inside the trim. TOP and LEFT runs: the moonline, a 1.1pt silver #9fb3cc line with a .45pt #e6eef8 highlight 1.5pt inside. RIGHT and BOTTOM runs: 1.1pt brass #b3722f with a .45pt #f3d58f highlight. Cold meets warm at two flat joining plates: top-right at (852,12) and bottom-left at (12,636), each a 16x8pt brass plate with a silver inlay line and 2 rivets. Bottom run broken at the folio.
border.entry: Top-left: a silver crescent-moon-and-star medallion (r 10pt, the banners' emblem in moon-silver and pale gold) at (16,16).
border.finish: Bottom-right: a brass corner cap (P039 kit-box cap construction, 34pt, warm gradient) with a soft lamp-gold glow (r 28pt, 35%) spilling onto the cream.
border.outer_band: None: the cream runs to the trim (bright opener rule, V09 §2). The frame lines carry the material.

P005.hero: The precision gauge: a full-height brass-and-glass thermometer standing between the lesson and the question, the first drawn maths of the book.

illustrate.what: QUESTION figure: precision gauge (SVG, painterly gradients)
illustrate.geometry: Glass tube centre x=448, width 22pt, from y=48 to y=600, brass collar fittings top and bottom (brass gradient) and a round bulb at the foot. Scale −15…15: 15 at y=60, −15 at y=588 (17.6pt per °C), so 0 at y=324, 12 at y=112.8, −12 at y=535.2. Fine engraved ticks every 1° (.5pt, 5pt long) and every 5° (.8pt, 9pt long) on the tube's right side, unlabelled except '0'. The 0 line is a 1.1pt silver bar across the tube and out 10pt each side, the moonline crossing the gauge.
illustrate.labels: ONLY: '0' (Source Sans 3 Semibold 14pt ink, right of the tube at y=324); a tag '12°C' (terracotta #B5603A text on a brass-edged ivory plate, 52x22pt) right of the tube at y=112.8 with a .6pt leader to the tick; a tag '−12°C' (teal #1F6F6B on a brass-edged pale-ice plate #E3ECF4) right of the tube at y=535.2. Two small reading beads in the tube at 12 (terracotta) and −12 (teal). No −2, no +10, no arrow in this figure.
illustrate.atmosphere: Left of the tube (x 372–430), two feathered painterly vignettes with NO labels, kept under 40% contrast so the ticks dominate: top (y 60–210), Sam's warm town, a lamp-lit pavilion-and-arch skyline crop from M01-D01 (upper-right pavilions) graded warm; bottom (y 440–590), Sarah's cold town, the same crop graded cold with frost and snow (reuse design/a4-tools/p005_scene.py's frost grade). Both fade irregularly into the cream.
illustrate.placement: beside the question (C1/C2), before the answer block

illustrate.what: ANSWER figure: number line inside C3 only (SVG)
illustrate.geometry: −12 to 12, 11pt per unit (x from 562 to 826), ticks every 1 (.5pt), labels ONLY −12, −2, 0, 12 (Source Sans 3 14pt). Points: −12 teal hollow ring, −2 teal solid, 12 terracotta solid. A teal arc from −12 to −2 with the label '+10' above it (teal, 13pt Semibold). 0 tick 1pt taller.

P005.colour: Cream reading field. Teal = Sarah's cold tracked temperature (and the moon-silver border runs), terracotta + lamp gold = Sam's warm side (and the brass border runs). Greyscale-safe because the tags differ by plate tint and the beads by fill.
delights: Fine rime crystals creep up the gauge's glass from the bulb on its LEFT edge only, as white-blue hairlines (#ffffff at 35%, no star shapes), and stop exactly at the silver 0 bar. They stay clear of the ticks and tags.
Lamp-gold haze (#f7c684 radial at 18%) pools behind the warm half of the tube above 0, so the gauge itself is half lamp-lit and half moonlit.
The border is the street's moonline: silver top-left, brass bottom-right, locked together at two flat joining plates, so cold meets warm at the page edge.
